result.title: Most wins of the League of Legends European Championships
result.content: The record for the most wins of the League of Legends European Championships is 12 and was achieved by "Rasmus "Caps" Borregaard Winther in Berlin, Germany, on 14 April 2024. Caps, known as King of Hats by his Chinese fan base, was the 2nd player to reach 2000 kills in the LEC and the 4th to reach 300 wins. He also has the most LEC Finals MVPs at 5.

result.content: The League of Legends World Championship 2024 (also known as LoL Worlds 2024 or just Worlds 2024) is the crowning event of League of Legends esports for the year. The tournament includes 20 teams from all regions of the game in a months-long race for the Summoner's Cup.
